thread:
maya: Quick sync  ACME private pilot asked for deterministic 99th percentile <120ms on short chats + HSM key access for tenant keys. We need to map cross-team deps and a launch checklist.

alex: Thanks  do we have an initial SLO/acceptance checklist from acct team?

maya: @alex copied the customer's email  short version: p99 <120ms for <=256 tokens, canary with 5% traffic, automatic fallback to smaller model but no plaintext key export. They want go/no-go by 4/30.

sam: Runtime notes: to hit p99 we need prewarm slots + prefix cache warm for common prompts. Also risk: quantized LLM variant introduces minor quality delta (2% rouge).

julia: Infra: prewarm + reserved burst needs capacity reservation in Dedicated pool (6 GPUs for first 2 weeks). We need quota ticket + cost approval.

pete: Security checklist: HSM integration certs, KMS policy, threat model signoff. Also need encryption-in-transit proof for private control plane.

maya: Proposed plan: 1) Product defines acceptance tests (perf + quality), 2) Runtime implements prewarm + KV caching, 3) Infra reserves capacity + networking, 4) Security completes HSM signoff, 5) Eng implements canary rollout hooks and metric dashboards.

alex: Can you put specific owners/times? I can own the canary rollout code + fallback.

maya: Owners: alex (canary + fallback)  4/18, sam (runtime prewarm + cache)  4/15, julia (capacity & infra)  ticket by 4/10, pete (security signoff)  4/22.

sam: Implementation detail: I'll add a two-tier prewarm  warm the KV cache on control-path for tenant prefix, and keep N warm slots with continuous batching. Patch to runtime will look like:

```
add_prewarm(tenant_id, model_variant, slots=4)
prewarm_prefix_cache(tenant_id, prefixes=["common:qna","help:"])
```

alex: For canary routing config, we'll use rollout weights + health checks in the router:

```
route {
  match tenant == "acme" 
  rollout { stable: 95, canary: 5 }
  fallback: model-small
}
```

julia: Infra action: open ticket to capacity-billing with sizing and ask for burst window 4/20-5/04. Also need VPC peering checklist for their private pod.

pete: Security: two open items  HSM attestation (customer requires FIPS/HSM chain) and KMS key wrapping for model cache. I can draft a security plan doc by 4/12.

maya: Risk table quick:
- Perf miss if prewarm insufficient -> rollback to smaller model (alex)
- Quality regression from quant -> threshold reject in evals (sam)
- Capacity overspend -> cost cap + alert (julia)
- Compliance gap -> delay to next window (pete)

alex: What are launch criteria exactly? I propose: 1) perf p99 <=120ms under 5% canary for 24h, 2) quality delta <=3% on agreed eval set, 3) HSM signoff, 4) capacity confirmed + cost cap.

maya: Agreed. Add monitoring: token-level latency, per-route p99, error rate, fallback rate. Also need runbook for fast rollback.

sam: I'll add metric hooks: tag requests with tenant and variant, emit prewarm hit rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio.

julia: I'll set up a dashboard template and alert: if p99 > 150ms or fallback_rate > 1% -> paged.

pete: Security signs off conditionally: HSM attestation + KMS policy in place. If either missing, we block.

maya: Customer ask also included export controls for logs  redact tokens and store only hashed prompts. Need ops confirmation.

alex: We'll add a scrubber on the control plane before logs land in S3. I can ship a lightweight filter.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued  1766010700  preflight checks running.

maya: Next steps: julia opens capacity ticket today, pete drafts sec plan by 4/12, sam lands runtime prewarm PR by 4/15, alex sets canary code + scrubber by 4/18, product to run acceptance tests 4/25-4/29. I'll coordinate a dry-run 4/26.

alex: ack, I'll ping infra for network windows.

sam: ack, starting design doc now.

julia: ack, ticket created: CAP-4021, assigned to billing.

pete: ack, creating sec-doc PR.

maya: Thanks  keeping this thread as the single source for owners/ dates. If anyone hits a hard blocker call me and we'll re-evaluate the go/no-go. :thumbsup:
